title: Qualify finite continuous distribution boundaries and portable seeded checkpoints
commitMessage: feat: qualify distribution boundaries and close reproducible randomness

contribution.summary: Qualify finite binary64 continuous-uniform PDF/CDF/quantile and reproducible half-open sampling, plus canonical versioned SplitMix64 seed/counter checkpoints. Preserve the already qualified Bernoulli p=0/1 conventions and noncryptographic limits. Observe compiled RED, 30 independent GREEN tests, 166 complete statistics tests, pertinent regression checks and a local preview.6 package; complete T2 and C03 while keeping M3-W02 in progress.
contribution.value: Make discrete versus approximate continuous distribution conventions, finite overflow refusals and stable checkpoint interoperability explicit without inventing a normal-distribution provider, cross-repository adoption or secure randomness.
debtChanges: ContinuousUniformDistribution64 is restricted to finite ordered endpoints with representable width and inverse density; PDF/CDF/inverse use approximate binary64.
The uniform CDF saturates at exact bounds; quantile(1) returns upper, while samples strictly exclude upper using a BitDecrement clamp after rounding.
Portable SplitMix64PositionCodec encodes exact algorithm, seed and consumed counter in strict lowercase invariant 16-digit hexadecimal fields.
Bernoulli p=0/1 positive-mass quantiles, existing golden vectors and single-word sampling remain unchanged and independently regression tested.
SplitMix64 is noncryptographic; no random entropy, password/secret suitability or universal statistical quality can be inferred.
Normal/Gaussian tails, arbitrary unbounded streams, across-RID verification and robust nonlinear distribution approximations remain unqualified.
No Decision/MCDM consumer implementation, neutral dw.discovery admission, AURA brokerage or public NuGet feed publication is authorized.
contribution.nextAction: On durable RS049 success, inspect accepted M3-W02-C04 consumer contract scope and prepare one evidence-backed Decision/MCDM mathematical-interface run without mutating sibling repositories.

achievements.achievement: Compile and observe a controlled reflection RED against preview.5 for absent continuous-uniform and versioned seed/counter serialization contracts.

Implement finite approximate continuous-uniform density/CDF/quantile and half-open seeded sampling plus strict canonical SplitMix64/v1 checkpoint codec, preserving T1 mathematical and bitwise contracts.
Pass 30 independent T2 GREEN cases and 166 complete statistics tests, related numerical and rational regressions, locked .NET build, local provider-free preview.6 package checks and durable evidence.
Qualify C03-T2 finite/invalid parameter boundaries, discrete-versus-continuous quantile conventions, seed/counter restoration and explicit noncryptographic consumer restrictions.
Close C03 with T1 independently qualified Bernoulli/PRNG basics and T2 finite continuous approximation/checkpoint evidence, leaving M3-W02 active for C04 consumer research.
